gates.description: Procedures declared mandatory: lint before run, least-privilege permissions, pinned actions, dry-run before enable, no self-modifying CI

gates.name: 1.1 Pipeline stages specified before YAML: stage graph (lint → t
gates.description: Pipeline stages specified before YAML: stage graph (lint → typecheck → test → build → package → deploy-gate) with per-stage failure semantics and parallelism decisions written down
gates.command: .rig/cicd/stage-graph.md with stages, dependencies (needs:), and failure policy per stage

gates.name: 1.2 Trigger audit: on: block reviewed — no pull_request_target w
gates.description: Trigger audit: on: block reviewed — no pull_request_target with checkout of untrusted code, no overly broad branch filters, scheduled jobs carry timezone note
gates.command: .rig/cicd/trigger-review.md with per-trigger verdict and the pull_request_target check explicitly answered

gates.name: 1.3 Caching strategy stated: dependency cache keys include lockf
gates.description: Caching strategy stated: dependency cache keys include lockfile hash; cache fallbacks named; no cache poisoning path from PR builds into main-branch caches
gates.command: Workflow YAML cache keys grep-verified; poison-path analysis in stage-graph.md

gates.name: 2.1 Actions pinned to commit SHAs: every uses: reference is a fu
gates.description: Actions pinned to commit SHAs: every uses: reference is a full-length SHA with a version comment; no @main/@vN floating tags on third-party actions
gates.command: grep -nE 'uses: .+@(?! [0-9a-f]{40})' (or ratchet output) over workflow files returns empty; .rig/cicd/pins.txt lists each action+SHA

gates.name: 2.2 Least-privilege permissions: top-level permissions: block st
gates.description: Least-privilege permissions: top-level permissions: block starts at contents: read (or {}) and each job elevates only what it needs; no write-all, no id-token: write without a named OIDC audience
gates.command: Permissions blocks pasted into .rig/cicd/permissions-review.md with per-job justification

gates.name: 2.3 Secret hygiene: secrets referenced via environment protectio
gates.description: Secret hygiene: secrets referenced via environment protection rules; no secrets echoed, masked-bypass patterns, or passed to untrusted PR contexts; secrets: inherit audited
gates.command: grep for secrets. usages tabulated in .rig/cicd/secrets-audit.txt; each use tied to a protected environment or justified

gates.name: 2.4 No curl-pipe-shell or unpinned installers: remote install sc
gates.description: No curl-pipe-shell or unpinned installers: remote install scripts absent or pinned by version+checksum; package installs use lockfiles
gates.command: grep -nE 'curl .*\| (ba)?sh' over workflows empty or each hit has checksum verification adjacent

gates.name: 3.1 Workflow lint clean: actionlint (plus zizmor for security fi
gates.description: Workflow lint clean: actionlint (plus zizmor for security findings) run over every changed workflow file, exit 0 or findings dispositioned
gates.command: .rig/cicd/actionlint.txt and zizmor output attached; dispositions listed

gates.name: 3.2 Local dry-run: the workflow executed locally with act (or th
gates.description: Local dry-run: the workflow executed locally with act (or the job commands run in a clean container matching the runner image) and the critical path is green
gates.command: .rig/cicd/dry-run.txt with act output or container run exit codes; deviations from runner environment noted

gates.name: 3.3 Failure-path test: at least one intentional-failure scenario
gates.description: Failure-path test: at least one intentional-failure scenario traced (flaky test retry policy, deploy-gate rejection, rollback job) and the pipeline's behavior matches the spec

gates.name: 3.4 Timeout & concurrency guards: every job has timeout-minutes;
gates.description: Timeout & concurrency guards: every job has timeout-minutes; concurrency groups with cancel-in-progress set deliberately for branch vs main vs deploy workflows
gates.command: grep audit in .rig/cicd/guards.txt: every job shows timeout-minutes; concurrency blocks reviewed

gates.name: 4.1 Runbook written: how to read a red pipeline, how to re-run,
gates.description: Runbook written: how to read a red pipeline, how to re-run, how to rotate a secret used by the pipeline, how to disable the pipeline in an emergency

gates.name: 4.2 Improvement entry written: one reusable composite action can
gates.description: Improvement entry written: one reusable composite action candidate, one flaky-class observed, or one harness gap

preconditions.startup_phrase: A pipeline is production code that ships production code. It gets reviewed twice.
preconditions.bms_bias: A2 for workflow authoring; A1 for lint/dry-run verification; A3 for docs; A4 forbidden (no live workflow_dispatch, no deploy)

self_improvement.update_trigger: same CI fault recurs 3+ times → composite action, org-level ruleset, or branch-protection change proposed

success_conditions: All gates passed or degraded-with-log; zero unresolved halt gates, zero stop events
actionlint + zizmor clean or dispositioned; actions SHA-pinned
Dry-run evidence attached; failure paths traced
Identity closure: coordinate, pipeline verdict, next safe action stated
failure_states: notes: enabling or triggering a live pipeline against the real repo is an outward action — deferred to Gate-D; this harness proves the pipeline locally
stop gate(s) 2.3: session halts; human Gate-D approval required before any continuation or outward action
halt gate(s) 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 2.4, 3.1, 3.2, 3.4, 4.2: no progress without gate evidence
degrade gate(s) 1.3, 3.3, 4.1: continue with deficit logged in the Definition of Done waiver
quality_criteria: Startup phrase spoken and the pipeline target pinned: CI system (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Buildkite), repo, and the events the pipeline serves (push, PR, tag, schedule)
Procedures declared mandatory: lint before run, least-privilege permissions, pinned actions, dry-run before enable, no self-modifying CI
RIG coordinate stated before the first workflow edit
Harness tuple H_cicd(pipeline_spec, lint_proof, dry_run, supply_chain, improvement) declared
Pipeline stages specified before YAML: stage graph (lint → typecheck → test → build → package → deploy-gate) with per-stage failure semantics and parallelism decisions written down
Trigger audit: on: block reviewed — no pull_request_target with checkout of untrusted code, no overly broad branch filters, scheduled jobs carry timezone note
Caching strategy stated: dependency cache keys include lockfile hash; cache fallbacks named; no cache poisoning path from PR builds into main-branch caches
Actions pinned to commit SHAs: every uses: reference is a full-length SHA with a version comment; no @main/@vN floating tags on third-party actions
Least-privilege permissions: top-level permissions: block starts at contents: read (or {}) and each job elevates only what it needs; no write-all, no id-token: write without a named OIDC audience
Secret hygiene: secrets referenced via environment protection rules; no secrets echoed, masked-bypass patterns, or passed to untrusted PR contexts; secrets: inherit audited
No curl-pipe-shell or unpinned installers: remote install scripts absent or pinned by version+checksum; package installs use lockfiles
Workflow lint clean: actionlint (plus zizmor for security findings) run over every changed workflow file, exit 0 or findings dispositioned
Local dry-run: the workflow executed locally with act (or the job commands run in a clean container matching the runner image) and the critical path is green
Failure-path test: at least one intentional-failure scenario traced (flaky test retry policy, deploy-gate rejection, rollback job) and the pipeline's behavior matches the spec
Timeout & concurrency guards: every job has timeout-minutes; concurrency groups with cancel-in-progress set deliberately for branch vs main vs deploy workflows
Runbook written: how to read a red pipeline, how to re-run, how to rotate a secret used by the pipeline, how to disable the pipeline in an emergency
Improvement entry written: one reusable composite action candidate, one flaky-class observed, or one harness gap

final_rule: Lint before run; dry-run before enable.
SHA pins or it doesn't ship.
A secret leak in CI stops the world.
No improvement entry, no session complete.
Every ci-cd-design session leaves the system stronger than it found it.
